nusmp.skill.book_modification.descriptio: Morris Libardirt's attribute: change the structure of things - needles that thread through matter, clawed tendrils out of the ground, a field that unravels barriers, a shock of rewritten air, a body that re-forms against the kind of blow that has been hurting it. Cast it and the Dissector's Frame forms: bone and steel plates, a ribcage over your chest, four tendrils from your back, a ring of needles over your head. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_b: Modification: Dissection Needles - three to five needles fly from your hand in a fan; each pierces the first foe it meets and weakens it. More needles for more EP.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_c: Modification: Clawed Tendrils - tendrils climb out of the ground under up to four foes within sixteen blocks, strike and drag them toward you (the drag uses the shared control lock).
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_f: Modification: Structural Unravel - a field laid at the aimed point for four seconds: barriers and enemy shots in it are broken as it opens, and foes in it are slowed, weakened and slowly cut.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_d: Modification: Structure Shock - a blast of rewritten air all round you: a hard hit and a shove outwards on every foe within six and a half blocks. The five-second Frame forms.
nusmp.page.book_modification.attribute_g: Modification: Re-Structure - for nine seconds your body re-forms against the kind of blow that has been hurting it (melee, ranged or magic): a quarter to two fifths off that kind, but every other kind finds a hole. Vary your defence; the Frame forms.
nusmp.page.book_modification.specimen_th: Modification: Specimen Mark - a thread to the foe you look at: it is drawn slowly toward you (a walker can always walk away), drained and cut every second, and dissected when it arrives. Hard control: shares the twelve-second lock.
nusmp.page.book_modification.spell_rewri: Modification: Spell Rewrite - for four seconds the enemy shots that come within four and a half blocks of you are rewritten into needles and thrown back at their shooters, up to six.
nusmp.page.book_modification.test_subjec: Modification: Test Subjects - two (three for a mighty caster) edited humans with blade arms and claws rise for thirty seconds, follow you and cut the nearest foe.
nusmp.page.book_modification.dissection_: Modification: Dissection Theatre - a ring of tendrils closes round the aimed point from eight blocks to three over five seconds, with two doors; whoever touches the wall from inside is cut, and the squeeze at the end hits hard.
nusmp.page.book_modification.dissector_f: Dissector's Frame - the Frame for twenty seconds: eleven pieces forge in on your body and a ring of needles circles your head, firing one at the nearest foe every second or two. A fifth to three tenths off every blow. Resistance I.
